title: Expressing Opinions
summary: 表达观点、赞同反对、解释原因和条件句。
objectives: Support an opinion with reasons and examples
Compare choices and suggest a compromise

lessons.title: In My Opinion
lessons.subtitle: 表达观点并用例子支持

vocabulary.example: I think trains are convenient.
I see your point about the cost.
As a result, the queues were shorter.

listening.title: In My Opinion
listening.transcript: I prefer trains to coaches on long journeys. There’s more space to move around, and I can work at a table. Coaches are often cheaper, though.

questions.q: Why does the speaker prefer trains?
options: More space and a place to work
questions.answer: More space and a place to work

speaking.prompt: 就旅游交通说出明确偏好、理由和一个具体例子。
speaking.sample: I think trains are better on long trips because I can move around. For example, I can walk to another carriage.

reading.title: 表达观点并用例子支持
reading.text: Some visitors prefer a city pass because it includes transport and museums. Others buy separate tickets because they only plan to visit one museum.

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词推荐一种出行方式，同时承认它的一项缺点。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（I think ... because ...；For example ...）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: For example 用来引出具体例子。
convenient 在本课中指方便的。
quiz.prompt: What does “convenient” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: I See Your Point
lessons.subtitle: 礼貌表示部分赞同与不同意
grammar: I see your point, but ...；I agree that ...

vocabulary.example: I see your point about the cost.
As a result, the queues were shorter.
We have two options for Saturday.

listening.title: I See Your Point
listening.transcript: I agree that the early train is cheaper, but it leaves before the first bus. If we take it, we’ll need a taxi. I’d rather pay a bit more for the later train.

questions.q: What problem does the early train cause?

speaking.prompt: 先认可对方一条理由，再礼貌说明你的顾虑。
speaking.sample: I see your point about the price, but the later train is easier to reach.

reading.title: 礼貌表示部分赞同与不同意
reading.text: Our team can work from home two days a week. Nadia likes the flexibility. Leon agrees it saves travel time, but he prefers to discuss new projects in person.

questions.q: Why does Leon prefer meeting in person?
options: To avoid speaking to the team

writing.prompt: 写一段 8 行对话，双方各给理由并找出一个共同点。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（I see your point, but ...；I agree that ...）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 先认可对方观点，再用 but 引出分歧。

quiz.prompt: What does “point” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Reasons and Results
lessons.subtitle: 区分原因与结果
grammar: because 引出原因，so 引出结果

vocabulary.example: As a result, the queues were shorter.
I see your point about the cost.
I think trains are convenient.

listening.title: Reasons and Results
listening.transcript: The museum opened an extra gallery because the main room was crowded. As a result, visitors had more space and the queue moved faster.

questions.q: Why did the museum open the gallery?

speaking.prompt: 说明一个城市服务的改变，用 because 讲原因、用 so 讲结果。
speaking.sample: The main room was crowded, so the museum opened an extra gallery.

reading.title: 区分原因与结果
reading.text: The city added a late bus to help night workers get home. More workers started using public transport, so fewer cars were parked near the hospital.

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词解释一个日常问题、采取的行动和结果。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（because 引出原因，so 引出结果）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 前句给原因，so 引出结果。
quiz.prompt: The room was full, ___ we waited outside.
What does “result” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: If We Leave Earlier
lessons.subtitle: 用真实条件比较选择
grammar: If + 一般现在时，主句用 will 或 can

vocabulary.example: We have two options for Saturday.
As a result, the queues were shorter.
I see your point about the cost.

listening.title: If We Leave Earlier
listening.transcript: If we leave at eight, we’ll avoid the traffic, but the café won’t be open. If we leave at nine, we can get coffee first, but the roads may be busier.

questions.q: What is an advantage of leaving at eight?

speaking.prompt: 给出两种出发选择，每种说一个可能的结果和取舍。
speaking.sample: If we leave at eight, we’ll avoid traffic. If we leave at nine, we can have breakfast first.

reading.title: 用真实条件比较选择
reading.text: If the group pays before Friday, the guide can offer a lower price. If fewer than six people sign up, the normal price applies. The tour lasts two hours either way.

questions.q: What happens if fewer than six sign up?

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词比较两个计划，每个计划包含一个条件和它的结果。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（If + 一般现在时，主句用 will 或 can）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 开放的未来条件通常用一般现在时。
quiz.prompt: If they ___ before Friday, they’ll get a lower price.
What does “option” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: An Imaginary Choice
lessons.subtitle: 讨论假设情境和偏好
grammar: If + 过去式，主句用 would + 原形

vocabulary.example: Imagine that you had a month off.
We have two options for Saturday.
As a result, the queues were shorter.

listening.title: An Imaginary Choice
listening.transcript: If I had a month off, I’d travel by train across Europe. I’d spend a week in each city so I could get to know the place.

speaking.prompt: 假设你有一个月假期，谈选择、理由和想做的两件事。
speaking.sample: If I had a month off, I’d visit three cities and travel by train.

reading.title: 讨论假设情境和偏好
reading.text: If the town had more space, Mia would build an outdoor cinema. Raj would choose a sports centre instead because it could be used all year.

writing.prompt: 写 90–110 词回应「如果社区有空地，你会建什么」。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（If + 过去式，主句用 would + 原形）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 假设当前条件不同，用 would 表示设想的结果。
quiz.prompt: If I had more time, I ___ learn another language.
What does “imagine” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: A Fair Compromise
lessons.subtitle: 权衡双方需求并达成妥协
grammar: on the one hand ... on the other hand ...；I suggest ...

vocabulary.example: We reached a compromise.
Imagine that you had a month off.
We have two options for Saturday.

listening.title: A Fair Compromise
listening.transcript: One group wants a long walk, and the other wants time to shop. I suggest we walk together for an hour, then split into two groups before meeting for dinner.

questions.q: What will everyone do together first?

speaking.prompt: 扮演组织者，先总结两方需求，再提出一个兼顾两方的方案。
speaking.sample: On the one hand, we want to save money. On the other hand, we need a quiet room. I suggest staying outside the centre.

reading.title: 权衡双方需求并达成妥协
reading.text: Three friends are booking a room. One wants the cheapest room, and another needs a quiet place to work. A quiet room outside the centre is within budget, but it adds a bus ride.

questions.q: What is the drawback of the compromise?

writing.prompt: 写 90–110 词描述一个小组分歧、不同需求和折中方案。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（on the one hand ... on the other hand ...；I suggest ...）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Compromise 是各方调整要求后达成的折中方案。
options: Meet some needs on both sides
quiz.answer: Meet some needs on both sides
quiz.prompt: What does a compromise aim to do?

quiz.explanation: compromise 在本课中指折中办法。
quiz.prompt: What does “compromise” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Weekly Challenge: Choose Together
lessons.subtitle: 以证据说服同伴并接受备选
grammar: 综合观点、让步及条件句

vocabulary.example: Staying within budget is our priority.
We reached a compromise.
Imagine that you had a month off.

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Choose Together
listening.transcript: The gallery trip costs twelve pounds and works in any weather. The garden trip costs eight, but the tickets cannot be moved to another day. I’d pick the gallery if the forecast looks bad.

questions.q: Which choice works in any weather?

speaking.prompt: 为六人推荐一项活动，引用票价和天气条件，礼貌回应反对意见。
speaking.sample: I see your point about the garden price, but six of us get the gallery discount. If it rains, I think the gallery is better.

reading.title: 以证据说服同伴并接受备选
reading.text: Our group has £10 per person. The gardens cost £8 and close at four. The gallery costs £12, but groups of six or more pay £10 each. Six people have confirmed.

questions.q: Can this group afford the gallery?
options: Only if two people stay home

writing.prompt: 写 100–120 词说明你给小组的建议、一个反方观点和备用方案。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（综合观点、让步及条件句）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: If 连接条件，主句交代对应结果。
options: If it rains, we’ll choose the gallery.
quiz.answer: If it rains, we’ll choose the gallery.
quiz.prompt: Which sentence connects a recommendation to a condition?

quiz.explanation: priority 在本课中指优先考虑的事。
quiz.prompt: What does “priority” mean in this lesson?
